description: This file defines the LoadGrain class, which implements a grain for benchmarking purposes. It manages the generation and resolution of ping operations across multiple grains, tracks success and failure counts, and measures elapsed time.

classes.name: LoadGrain
classes.description: A Benchmark grain that generates and manages ping requests to other grains, collecting performance metrics.

methods.name: Generate
methods.description: Starts the generation of ping tasks for a specified number of runs and concurrent connections.

methods.name: TryGetReport
methods.description: Signals completion and retrieves the current report of ping success/failure counts.

methods.name: RunGeneration
methods.description: Runs the main loop that dispatches ping requests and waits for their completion, measures elapsed time.

methods.name: ResolvePending
methods.description: Resolves pending ping tasks, updates the report with success or failure counts.
